name: Hanger steak
definition: beef steak from the hanging tender of the diaphragm (onglet).
reason: Named retail cut (J-1); hanger not shown in the fetched summaries; to HV_J1_NK.

name: Tri-tip

reason: Named retail cut is the kind for beef and pork (J-1, memo 4b); no kind covers it.

name: Rib roast (standing rib, prime rib)
definition: beef roasting joint from the rib section, bone-in or boneless.
reason: Roast and steak from one section are different retail cuts (ribeye is the steak); J-1.

name: Eye of round
definition: lean cylindrical beef roast from the round (hindquarter).
reason: Named retail cut is the kind for beef and pork (J-1, memo 4b); no kind covers it.

name: Top round (topside)
definition: beef roasting joint or steak from the inside of the round.
reason: Named retail cut is the kind for beef and pork (J-1, memo 4b); no kind covers it.

name: Oxtail
definition: the tail of cattle, sold raw in sections to braise.

name: Beef liver
definition: the liver of cattle, sold raw.
reason: Offal is the organ per animal (memo 4b, J-3).

name: Beef heart

reason: Offal is the organ per animal (memo 4b, J-3).

name: Beef kidney
definition: the kidney of cattle, sold raw.
reason: Offal is the organ per animal (memo 4b, J-3).

name: Veal flank

name: Pork shoulder joint (picnic)

reason: Named retail cut is the kind for beef and pork (J-1, memo 4b); no kind covers it.

name: Pork leg (fresh ham)

reason: Named retail cut is the kind for beef and pork (J-1, memo 4b); no kind covers it.

name: Pork stomach (maw)

name: Lamb shoulder

reason: Named lamb cut shown sold on a fetched page (memo 4b).

name: Lamb shank
definition: the lower leg of a lamb, sold raw to braise.

name: Chicken wings

name: Duck leg

name: Guinea fowl, whole or jointed

name: Squirrel

name: Gammon
definition: pork hind leg wet- or dry-cured and sold raw as a joint or steaks to be cooked.
